sub_graphs.title: Gloas: Execution Payload Bid Lifecycle
sub_graphs.description: Models the lifecycle of builder bids from construction through gossip broadcast and proposer acceptance

nodes.label: Builder Active with Sufficient Balance
nodes.description: Builder has been activated via deposit, has builder_index and sufficient excess balance for bid value

nodes.label: Request Payload from Execution Engine
nodes.description: Call engine_getPayloadV5 to generate execution payload with transactions

nodes.label: Construct SignedExecutionPayloadBid
nodes.description: Assemble bid with parent_block_hash, parent_block_root, block_hash, blob_kzg_commitments, builder_index, slot, value, and fee_recipient

nodes.label: Sign Bid with Builder Key
nodes.description: Compute signing_root with DOMAIN_BEACON_BUILDER and sign with builder's private key

nodes.label: Bid Broadcast on Gossip
nodes.description: SignedExecutionPayloadBid published on execution_payload_bid gossip topic

nodes.label: Bid Accepted by Proposer
nodes.description: Proposer includes bid commitment in beacon block, builder obligated to pay

nodes.label: Bid Not Selected
nodes.description: Proposer chose a different bid or built locally

edges.label: Builder requests payload from execution engine
Proposer includes bid in beacon block

external_entities.name: Execution Engine
external_entities.description: Builder's local execution client providing payloads via engine_getPayloadV5

external_entities.name: Block Proposer
external_entities.description: Validator proposing the beacon block who selects a builder bid

sub_graphs.title: Gloas: Execution Payload Envelope Construction and Delivery
sub_graphs.description: Models the builder's obligation to deliver the execution payload envelope after bid acceptance

nodes.label: Builder Bid Accepted in Block
nodes.description: Proposer's beacon block includes the builder's bid commitment

nodes.label: Assemble Execution Payload Envelope
nodes.description: Set payload matching bid block_hash, attach execution_requests, builder_index, beacon_block_root, slot

nodes.label: Process Execution Payload (verify=False)
nodes.description: Run process_execution_payload on state copy without execution engine verification to compute state_root

nodes.label: Compute Post-State Root
nodes.description: Set envelope.state_root = hash_tree_root(state) after payload processing

nodes.label: Sign Envelope with Builder Key
nodes.description: Sign envelope with DOMAIN_BEACON_BUILDER domain

nodes.label: Envelope Broadcast on Gossip
nodes.description: SignedExecutionPayloadEnvelope published on execution_payload topic

nodes.label: Block Non-Canonical Detected
nodes.description: Builder detects accepted bid's block is not chain head

nodes.label: Payload Withheld
nodes.description: Builder legitimately withholds payload for non-canonical block

edges.label: Run state transition without engine verification
Builder detects block not at chain head

sub_graphs.title: Gloas: Builder Payment Obligation and Security Model
sub_graphs.description: Models the unconditional payment mechanism and security boundaries of the builder-proposer relationship

nodes.label: Bid Value Committed
nodes.description: Builder's bid includes value (gwei) that will be paid to proposer unconditionally upon acceptance

nodes.label: Check Builder Excess Balance
nodes.description: Verify builder has sufficient excess balance to cover bid value for all pending commitments

nodes.label: Builder Balance Sufficient
nodes.description: Builder has enough excess balance to honor the bid

nodes.label: Payment Enforced by Protocol
nodes.description: Builder pays proposer the bid value whether or not payload is delivered

nodes.label: Validate Builder Withdrawal Credentials
nodes.description: Verify withdrawal_credentials[:1] == 0x03 (BUILDER_WITHDRAWAL_PREFIX) with correct address format

nodes.label: Builder Identity Verified
nodes.description: Builder's on-chain identity confirmed via 0x03 credentials and builder_index

edges.label: Protocol enforces payment upon bid acceptance

external_entities.name: Builder Deposit Transaction
external_entities.description: On-chain deposit establishing builder identity with BUILDER_WITHDRAWAL_PREFIX (0x03)

ambiguities.text: The specification states builders must have 'sufficient excess balance for all pending commitments' but does not specify how concurrent bid values are tracked or aggregated.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume the protocol tracks total outstanding bid value across all unresolved bids and deducts from excess balance. This is an assumption.

ambiguities.text: The bid field 'execution_payment must equal zero for gossip broadcast' suggests different values for direct submission, but the alternative path is not fully specified.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume execution_payment is always zero for gossip-based bids and non-zero only for future direct builder-proposer channels. This is an assumption.

ambiguities.text: The specification does not detail what happens if a builder submits an envelope with a state_root that does not match the expected post-state.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume the envelope is rejected by validators during block processing if state_root is incorrect. This is an assumption.

implicit_assumptions.description: Builders trust their local execution engine (engine_getPayloadV5) to produce valid and profitable payloads.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Builders could submit invalid payloads, losing their committed bid value without receiving MEV revenue.

implicit_assumptions.description: An attacker cannot forge a builder's BLS signature to submit fraudulent bids on their behalf.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Fraudulent bids could drain a builder's balance through forced payment obligations.

implicit_assumptions.description: Network latency is low enough that builders can observe accepted bids and construct/broadcast envelopes within the slot time.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Builders may fail to deliver payloads in time, resulting in empty slots or unconditional payment without payload delivery.
